playbook.intent: An epic has sat at the top of the backlog through two sprints because nobody can pick it up without swallowing the whole thing at once. The session ends with it broken into pieces that each finish inside one sprint and each mean something to a user on their own, ordered with the reasoning written beside the order, and laid onto a story map where the first releasable slice is drawn as a line.
playbook.scope: One oversized epic or feature ends the session decomposed into INVEST-sized stories with prioritisation rationale, mapped to a story-map slice.

success-criteria.criterion: Nothing in the resulting set is too big to finish within a single sprint, and each piece delivers something a user would notice without waiting for its siblings
Each split names the seam it was cut along — a step in the workflow, a variation in the rules, a boundary in the data — so a reviewer can see why it broke there and not somewhere else
The ordering carries a written reason per item rather than a bare score, and the two people who disagreed at the start of the session can both live with where it landed
A horizontal line across the story map marks what ships first, and everything below it is deferred out loud rather than quietly dropped
Anything that resisted splitting is recorded as indivisible together with the constraint that blocks it, so whoever revisits it starts from the reason and not from scratch
